name: io.github.bsayres/heronhex-risk
title: Higher Ed: Risk
description: Title IV risk signals (HCM, composite scores, default rates) and Single Audit findings. Read-only.

environmentVariables.name: FAC_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Free api.data.gov key (https://api.data.gov/signup) for the Federal Audit Clearinghouse. Optional: without it the shared DEMO_KEY is used, which allows only about 10 requests.

environmentVariables.name: HIGHERED_MCPS_CACHE
environmentVariables.description: Directory for the local cache of downloaded public data (default ~/.cache/highered-mcps).
